This my maize plot is small, only about a quarter hectare, but the land is mine so I take care of it well. Last year the rains came late and my harvest was not so good, so this season I am careful with cash. I will buy one bag of NPK 20-10-10 and maybe half a bag of urea if the subsidy comes through the cooperative — for this small plot that is enough. I use improved seed because the agro-dealer in town sells it and my neighbor got better cobs last year with it; I weed with my wife and two older children, and I hire a few young men for land preparation because my back is not strong like before.
